scripts.report:structure: bash -lc 'if command -v tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then tree -a -I "node_modules|.git|uploads|dist|build|.cache" -L 4 > ../STRUTTURA-$(date +%F).md; else ls -R > ../STRUTTURA-$(date +%F).md; fi'
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p ../frontend/css-dist && find ../frontend/css -name '*.css' -type f | while read file; do rel="${file#../frontend/css/}"; dir="../frontend/css-dist/$(dirname "$rel")"; mkdir -p "$dir"; out="$dir/$(basename "$file")"; csso "$file" -o "$out"; done
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p ../frontend/js-dist && find ../frontend/js -name '*.js' -type f | while read file; do rel="${file#../frontend/js/}"; dir="../frontend/js-dist/$(dirname "$rel")"; mkdir -p "$dir"; out="$dir/$(basename "$file")"; npx terser "$file" -c -m -o "$out" 2>/dev/null || cp "$file" "$out"; done && echo '⚠️  Some files copied without minification due to syntax errors'
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && echo '✅ Build complete: CSS and JS minified in *-dist folders'
